episode_text: T2 RRF hybrid search implemented in retrieval_eval_kfold.py (--rrf flag). Full corpus results: P@1 cosine=0.640 -> RRF=0.799 (+0.158), MRR 0.694->0.850. Biggest gains: solution type +0.247, general project +0.320, ocreamer +0.272. In-memory FTS5 index, BM25+cosine fusion k=60. Baselines saved: kfold_report_rrf_full.json. meddefi casing fixed (31 rows -> MedDeFi). Ocreamer diagnosis: 192/206 memories are raw PDF chunks without titles, with overlapping adjacent embeddings -- an ingest problem not a retrieval problem. Next: wire RRF into production brain_api search path.

facts.content: RRF hybrid search implementation in retrieval_eval_kfold.py increased P@1 from 0.640 to 0.799 and MRR from 0.694 to 0.850 on full corpus results.
